name: The Iron Meridian
blurb: Sold to settle a debt you never made, you labor aboard Cassivel — a brass mountain adrift above a poisoned sea — where the engines that keep it aloft are the only thing everyone agrees to fight over.

name: The Last Lantern-Seed
blurb: High fantasy. The elven star-road is going dark and cold things walk through the gaps; you carry the last living lantern-seed to relight it — and someone you trust is unmaking the road from the far end.

name: The Almanac of Owed Names
blurb: Horror and mystery. A fog-locked harbor town lays extra chairs for its dead every autumn. You arrive to take the census and learn the ledger is a contract, and the names on it are changing.

name: The Weight of the Coffered God
blurb: Sword and sorcery. A mercenary company escorts a sealed reliquary across a salt waste, hunted by a warlord, a cult, and the thing in the box that wants out.

name: The Riverlight Masquerade (one-evening taster)
blurb: A single evening of intrigue: find which of five masked guests carries the forged treaty before the midnight toast. Short by design — a taste of the game.

name: The Silence Between Leaves
author: Pete Megow
blurb: A fairy-tale mystery. Stranded between rival fae courts, seek a missing prince, untangle dangerous bargains, and find your way home before the borderlands fall silent.

name: The Princess Is Not In Danger
blurb: Comic fantasy. A prophecy has chosen you and your hat to rescue a princess from a very polite dragon. Set off through a kingdom where tradition matters more than common sense.

name: The Road to Cinderwing
blurb: A fairy-tale adventure. Follow a missing princess from a haunted coastal mansion through an arena and an ancient forest to a dragon's mountain. Decide whom to trust along the way.
